pulls.title: Pull requests
pulls.sub: On the git host, most recently updated first. Open one to read and answer its comments.
pulls.unresolvedN: {n, plural, one {# unresolved thread} other {# unresolved threads}}
pulls.noFiles: The pull request changes no files.
pulls.noPatch: No diff to show (a binary file, or too large for the git host to send).
pulls.filesError: The changed files could not be read: {error}
pulls.earlierVersion: Written on an earlier version of this file:
pulls.deleteConfirm: It is deleted on the git host for everyone. This cannot be undone.
pulls.ticketSubOwn: Reviewers' comments on agnts's pull request. Answer here, or send them back to agnts.
pulls.ticketSubReview: The pull request's conversation on the git host.
pulls.addressConfirm: agnts goes back to {key} with {n, plural, one {this review thread} other {these # review threads}}: it changes the code or answers each. The fix waits for your approval as usual; once it is pushed, agnts replies in each thread.
pulls.addressed: {n, plural, one {# thread went} other {# threads went}} back to agnts
pulls.addressLater: {n, plural, one {# new review comment} other {# new review comments}}: they can go back to agnts while the ticket waits for your review, or once it is done with its pull request open.
pulls.postSub: One review on {host}, as the token's user. Findings on lines of the diff become comments there.
pulls.postBtn: {n, plural, =0 {Post} one {Post with # line comment} other {Post with # line comments}}
pulls.postSummary: The summary (the verdict and every finding)
pulls.summaryOnly: summary only: not a line of the diff
pulls.noRequestChanges: GitLab has no request for changes here: the comments are posted, approvals stay as they are.
pulls.set_attributionHelp: Comments written in agnts go out as the git host token's user; this adds "via agnts · your name" under each.
pulls.set_learnFromCommentsHelp: What you write on others' pull requests on the git host becomes notes on how you review.
pulls.set_resolveFixedHelp: Once agnts pushed a fix and answered a reviewer's thread, it resolves the thread.
pulls.set_autoAddressHelp: When a reviewer requests changes on agnts's pull request, its unresolved threads go back to the ticket by themselves. The fix still waits for your approval.
pulls.commentHint: Point at a line and click the comment button to comment on it.
